entities.name: @okie/scan
entities.responsibility: Deterministic TypeScript scanner that pins a git tree, emits bounded enrichment packets and concatenated prompts, and merges accepted ArchitectureExtraction documents through an atomic gate.

entities.name: src/cli.ts
entities.responsibility: okie-scan CLI: local or GitHub scan, packet/prompt emission, and --enrich-from merge of remainder packets.

entities.name: src/discover.ts
entities.responsibility: Deterministic git-ls-files discovery of TypeScript/JS source into workspace containers.

entities.name: src/enrich.ts
entities.responsibility: Atomic enrichment merge: hallucinated ids reject that document; remainder packets union summaries onto the same container.

entities.name: src/extract.ts
entities.responsibility: Syntax-only TypeScript extractor that maps files to C4 containers, file-components, and code entities.

entities.name: src/github.ts
entities.responsibility: Public GitHub tarball acquisition with anonymous REST plus optional gh-CLI fallback; tokens are scrubbed from errors.

entities.name: src/ids.ts
entities.responsibility: Deterministic typed stable-id derivation for scanned entities and relations.

entities.name: src/manifest.ts
entities.responsibility: Builds the slug-sorted fixtures/scan/index.json listing of scanned repositories.

entities.name: src/overview-story.ts
entities.responsibility: Synthesizes the deterministic C4 overview tour; accepted summaries may appear in narration, step count stays the tour.

entities.name: src/packet.ts
entities.responsibility: Builds bounded, redacted per-container packets; huge containers split into remainder packets so leftover file-components are not dropped.

entities.name: src/pin.ts
entities.responsibility: Pins commitSha, treeHash, and committer-date generatedAt so a re-scan of a SHA is byte-identical.

entities.name: src/prompt.ts
entities.responsibility: Concatenates the frozen enrichment-prompt.md with packet JSON and a SHA-stamped appendix — no templating.

entities.name: src/redact.ts
entities.responsibility: Scrubs GitHub-token-shaped secrets from packets and acquisition errors.

entities.name: src/scan.ts
entities.responsibility: Orchestrates pin → discover → extract → optional enrich → view/story/scene/timeline compile.

entities.name: src/scope.ts
entities.responsibility: Derives per-container file-component and code partitions the enrichment gate reasons over.
